description: This file defines a tool for taking screenshots within a browser automation context, including schema validation, screenshot handling, image scaling, and exporting the screenshot as an image or code snippet.

classes.name: screenshot
classes.description: A tab tool for capturing screenshots of the current page or element, with options for full page or element-specific screenshots.

methods.name: scaleImageToFitMessage
methods.description: Scales an image buffer to ensure it does not exceed size constraints (max 1.15 megapixels and linear size 1568).
